jobs.location_raw: Atlanta, GA · Los Angeles, CA · Alexandria, VA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Residential Maintenance Technician reports to the Property Manager under the supervision of the Maintenance Supervisor and performs general maintenance and repair to ensure apartment units and other property facilities are maintained per CIM Group operating and safety standards. Responsibilities include diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) units; electrical appliances, outlets, and light fixtures; plumbing, carpentry, and locks. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to, assisting with preparing vacant apartment units for rental and following a planned preventative maintenance schedule.

This role oversees monthly and quarterly accounting, consolidations, fair value measurement, and analytical review to support portfolio performance insights and decision making. The position partners closely with portfolio management, valuations, tax, treasury, as well as internal and external auditors to ensure the integrity of financial data throughout the investment lifecycle—from acquisition through disposition. The role also contributes to new investment onboarding, transaction activity, and ongoing liquidity management within complex investment structures.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Global Consultant Relations
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: CIM Group is a private alternatives asset manager with 30-years of experience and approximately $32 billion in assets under management. Our expertise spans private equity and credit investments across real estate and infrastructure, offering a range of funds across the risk-return spectrum as well as customized client solutions. The Institutional Client Group (ICG) builds and maintains relationships with institutional investors and intermediaries globally. ICG includes regional institutional sales teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC—primarily serving pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and endowments—as well as the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), which serves major insurance companies and banks, and Global Consultant Relations (GCR), which works with investment consultants, OCIO providers, and other asset managers. ICG is seeking a Senior Associate to join the Global Consultant Relations (GCR) Team. This role works alongside senior team members, contributes to key fundraising initiatives, and offers direct exposure to some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors. As a visible member of a collaborative, high‑performing team, the successful candidate will take ownership of select direct client relationships, targeted prospecting efforts, and contribute to and support the overall sales strategy, building a career at a respected and growing investment firm. This position is based at our office in Los Angeles, CA.

This is an excellent opportunity for a collaborative and results-driven real estate professional who enjoys taking ownership and making a measurable impact.

jobs.description_text: About the Role: The Business Development team at Hermeus is seeking a dynamic and innovative professional to expand our engagement with the defense and aviation enterprise. We are looking for a high-performer—someone who embraces challenges and consistently adds value in a fast-paced environment. We seek someone who can effectively represent our company’s vision to critical stakeholders, identify and pursue opportunities to enhance our government and national security efforts, while collaborating seamlessly with our engineering, operations, and product teams as we build the world’s fastest aircraft. Come join us and build a public-private partnership that will lead to a faster future.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer - Airbreathing Propulsion Test
jobs.description_text: About The Role: Hermeus is seeking a hands-on, technically rigorous Chief Engineer to lead the expansion of our High Enthalpy Airbreathing Test (HEAT) facility in Jacksonville, Florida. This is a high-ownership role for an engineer who has built, integrated, commissioned, and operated complex propulsion test infrastructure—and is ready to lead the next phase of capability development. You will own the technical execution of the facility expansion from requirements definition and architecture through design, construction, system integration, commissioning, and operational readiness. Working across propulsion engineering, test operations, facilities, contractors, and government stakeholders, you will translate demanding propulsion test objectives into safe, reliable, high-performance test capabilities. This is not simply a facilities project management role. We are looking for an engineer who understands how propulsion test systems work, can make sound technical decisions across interconnected systems, and can drive execution from concept to first operation. You will serve as the technical authority for the expansion, balancing test capability, safety, schedule, cost, and future scalability. Based on Hermeus’ rapid hardware development philosophy, you will have the opportunity to build test infrastructure that directly accelerates the development of advanced airbreathing propulsion systems.

You’ll lead a team of technicians through the development and execution of hydraulics, pressurized systems, sub-assemblies, and mechanisms, collaborating directly with engineering and operations to deliver high-reliability builds in a fast-paced environment. This role requires deep technical fluency, strong leadership skills, and a relentless drive to improve system quality, repeatability, and performance.

jobs.description_text: About the Role: Hermeus is hiring a regulatory compliance attorney to build and run its export control and trade compliance program. You will be the go-to advisor on ITAR, EAR, and related trade controls, own jurisdiction and classification work, and prepare export authorizations. This role sits on-site alongside the engineering teams, and that placement is deliberate. You will learn Hermeus' hardware, software, and technical data well enough to make sound classification and marking calls quickly. You will also shape compliance into engineering workflows from the start. This is a hands-on builder role. You will write the policies, train the workforce, make the classification calls, and file the licenses. You will also find ways to use AI tools to speed up the work and give employees self-service answers to routine compliance questions. Depending on your background, the role can also cover advising on CUI, proprietary and technical data protection, Department of War contracting and security requirements, FCPA, anti-bribery and corruption, ethics, and FAA and FCC regulatory matters. In addition, the role may support direct and indirect supplier and consultant agreements and intellectual property matters.

jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer
jobs.description_text: The Vehicle team builds the aircraft at the heart of Rainmaker’s cloud seeding operations. We design, build, and fly autonomous drones that go where other systems won’t. Our aircraft fly into icing, turbulence, high winds, and low visibility, because that’s where the clouds worth seeding are. We own the full flight system end to end: UAS: airframe, propulsion, avionics, and the autonomy that keeps our aircraft flying safely and reliably in severe weather. Dispersion payload: the hardware that delivers seeding material precisely, at the right place and time inside a cloud. Sensing systems: onboard instruments that measure the atmosphere around the aircraft, so we can see conditions as they happen and show what each mission accomplished. We’re a small, hands-on team that takes hardware from first sketch to field deployment. Engineers here design a part, test it on the bench, and watch it fly in conditions most drone programs would ground for. If you like hard problems where the environment fights back, and you want your work to put water on the ground, you’ll fit in here.

Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace, which makes the finance work here unusually interesting. You’ll dig into how supply and demand grow market by market, what drives our take rate, and what it costs to acquire a host or a renter. jobs.title: Marketplace Growth Associate
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Marketplace Growth Associate, you’ll work with Neighbor’s hosts: the commercial and residential property owners who list their storage and parking space on our marketplace. Hosts are the supply side of everything we do. The more easily renters can find a host’s space, the more that host earns and the faster the marketplace grows in every city we serve. You’ll be one of the people making that happen, one host at a time. Most of your day (50–75%) is outbound phone calls with hosts. On each call, you’ll help a host make their listing stronger and easier to find: setting up a Google Maps pin, tightening photos and descriptions, getting the price right, and building up reviews. The goal is to turn their space into steady, growing income. The rest of your time is operations: running the signage program, tracking results and finding ways to make the whole thing work better. This role fits you if you like being on the phone, you can manage a high volume of work on your own, and you tend to notice when a process could run better.
